1.why: The server verifies session ownership and checks that the account ID matches the authenticated user on all MFA endpoints while rejecting client-supplied account IDs.

2.why: Verification codes are strictly bound to individual user sessions and secrets, so a code generated for one user cannot work for another.

3.why: Session rotation explicitly deletes the previous session ID from memory upon authentication, invalidating prior sessions.

4.why: Authenticator secrets are encrypted using AES-GCM at rest and backup codes are stored as salted SHA-256 hashes.

5.why: All tokens, secrets, encryption IVs, and verification codes are generated using Web Crypto CSPRNG (`crypto.getRandomValues`).

6.why: Session tokens are stored exclusively in HttpOnly cookies and no sensitive credentials or tokens are persisted in localStorage or sessionStorage.

7.why: All server-side inputs including email, phone, OTPs, and secrets are strictly validated against length limits and expected regex formats.

8.why: User-supplied and dynamic values rendered into HTML are contextually encoded using `escapeHTML` alongside strict CSP nonces.

9.why: The application uses an API-only architecture with no HTTP redirect mechanisms, preventing open redirects.

10.why: Comprehensive security headers including CSP with frame-ancestors, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, and X-Frame-Options are set on responses.

11.why: Session cookies explicitly specify the HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite=Strict attributes.

12.why: Detailed stack traces are suppressed, generic error responses are returned, and sensitive secrets are omitted from logs and URLs.

13.why: Verification codes, setup drafts, and recovery codes enforce explicit time expiration limits and are consumed upon single use.

14.why: Failed attempts on identity verification, TOTP setup drafts, and recovery code verification are tracked and locked out after 5 failures.

15.why: Session identifiers are rotated upon state changes, subject to idle and absolute expiration timeouts, and invalidated on logout.
